19AS2026Q0031.title: U.S. Studies Conference Program Services
19AS2026Q0031.desc: Enclosed is a Request for Quotations (RFQ) for U.S. Studies Conference Program Services for the U.S. Embassy Canberra, Australia. Under this requirement, one-day conferences on U.S. foreign policy and the U.S. political system must be designed and delivered in three Australian cities: Canberra, Sydney, and Melbourne. If you would like to submit a quotation, follow the instructions in Section 3 of the solicitation, complete the required portions of the attached document, and submit it to the address shown on the Standard Form 1449.

19BA3026Q0003.title: Professional Curatorial Supervision
19BA3026Q0003.desc: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in the Kingdom of Bahrain will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. The Contractor shall provide professional curatorial supervision to: Plan, develop, and deliver a high-quality, culturally sensitive public exhibition celebrating Hamad and the Pirates (1971).  All qualified sources may submit a quotation which will be considered. The Government intends to award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the lowest priced technically acceptable offeror who is a responsible contractor. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a Fixed-Price Contract. The Government is planning a pre-quotation conference and the date for this conference will be in the solicitation.  SAM registration is not required; however, qualified offerors must have a valid CAGE/N-CAGE code for verification.

19TS8026Q0015.title: Hotel Services Notice ID :19TS8026Q0015
19TS8026Q0015.desc: The Embassy of the United States in Tunis, Tunisia, will release a solicitation for the acquisition of    Hotel Services including rental of conference and meeting rooms and catering services for 02 days for event that will be held in late September 2026. Please note the solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Tunis, Tunisia will launch this solicitation on the SAM.GOV website when it is available. The Government intends to award the contract resulting from this solicitation to the lowest priced technically acceptable offeror who is a responsible contractor. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a fixed price contract. All contractors have to be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) Database https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting an offer pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-7. Therefore, prospective offerors are encouraged to register at the earliest stage. The guidelines for registration in SAM are also available at: https://www.fsd.gov/fsd-gov/learning-center-system.do?sysparm_system=SAM

WEF27.title: Vehicle Services in Davos/Zurich, Switzerland, in Support of WEF27
WEF27.desc: U.S. Embassy Bern is conducting market research to identify vendors capable of providing vehicle services with English-speaking drivers in support of embassy officials attending the World Economic Forum 2027 (WEF27) in Davos, Zurich, and surrounding areas. Vehicle services are required for approximately one week prior to WEF27 and throughout the WEF27 conference week itself ( January 11, 2027 – January 22, 2027 ). Interested vendors must be able to demonstrate: Capacity to provide vehicles in various categories with drivers Drivers must be good in English Ability to operate in multiple locations (Davos, Zurich, and surrounding areas) Ability to meet requirements for transporting U.S. government staff Availability to adapt on short notice to changing group sizes. Interested parties should submit their proposal electronically to  BernGSOContracting@state.gov , including fleet inventory, vehicle categories, driver language qualifications, security features/certifications, and points of contact, by  26 August 2026 .

WEF2027.title: Lodging in Davos, Switzerland, in Support of WEF27
WEF2027.desc: U.S. Embassy Bern is conducting market research to identify vendors capable of providing short-term apartment lodging in Davos, Switzerland, in support of embassy officials attending the World Economic Forum 2027 (WEF27). Lodging is required for approximately one week prior to WEF27 and throughout the WEF27 conference week itself ( January 11, 2027 – January 22, 2027 ). The Embassy seeks apartment units in the following configurations: 1-bedroom apartments 2-bedroom apartments 3-bedroom apartments Interested vendors must be able to demonstrate: Capacity to provide the requested unit types in the Davos area for the full period noted above Ability to meet security and operational requirements for accommodating U.S. government staff Availability given the compressed planning window typical of WEF events Interested parties should submit their proposal electronically to  BernGSOContracting@state.gov , including apartment inventory, unit sizes, security features, and points of contact, by  26 August 2026 .
